NOTE
**Still not ready — the squash pulled about 120 unrelated files into the PR**

New: The author squashed the commits into one and updated the description. The diff grew from 2 files (+46/-11) to 123 files (+4994/-5409), covering the web app, docs, package files and more. Missing: the diff must contain only the scheduled-message fix and its test. There is also still no linked issue or maintainer sign-off that this change is wanted.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and don't assign a reviewer; the author needs to clean up the branch first.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for squashing! The PR now shows 123 changed files, most of them unrelated to the scheduled-message fix, which looks like a bad rebase or merge. Please rebase onto current `main` so the diff has only the fix and its test (see the [Git guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/git/index.html)).
```
